decision.summary: Two candidate temporary offsets identified within allowed context [445,579]. The first (530–539) is uncertain due to lack of return and divergent axis behavior (U drop unaccompanied by N/E). The second (540–549) is confirmed: synchronized multi-axis step with sustained interior and clear opposing return initiation at 550. No other intervals meet criteria for temporary offset (isolated spikes, smooth drifts, or permanent shifts excluded).

intervals.observation: U shows a sharp multi-sample drop starting at ~530, not mirrored in N/E; N rises gradually from ~480, E has a modest step near 520. No clear return observed before 540; interior sustained but axis responses diverge—U dominates magnitude, N/E lag/scale differently. Return not observed within allowed context (ends at 579), and post-540 behavior is dominated by a new step event.

Multi-axis step centered at 540–550: U drops sharply (~−12 to −16), E jumps up (~+25 to +30), N steps up (~+10 to +20). All three axes show coherent onset at index 540, sustained offset through 549, then partial return begins at 550 (U rebounds slightly, E/N decline). Return is incomplete by 579 and not monotonic; interior is stable over 10 samples. Confirmed temporary offset interval based on synchronized onset, sustained interior, and opposing return initiation.
